entities.name: Edith Austin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Edith Lucy Austin Greville was a Welsh tennis player who was active from 1888 until 1919. She was two time singles finalist at Wimbledon, and won 19 singles titles. She was married to fellow player George Greville.
